method: Primary documentation and independent review synthesis, not hands-on testing. Restored from source reads in the conversation after sandbox reset. Review battery/configuration passages cross-checked using original HTML.

sources.title: Install Android Studio
sources.finding: Studio alone minimum8GB; Studio+Emulator minimum16GB; recommended32GB. Windows/Linux tables specify x86 virtualization. Intel Mac support being phased out.

sources.title: VS Code requirements
sources.finding: Editor recommends1.6GHz/1GB, not whole workstation requirements.

sources.title: Xcode support
sources.finding: Exact Xcode versions require specific macOS ranges.

sources.title: WSL file systems
sources.finding: Keep projects in Linux filesystem when using WSL Linux tools rather than /mnt/c.

sources.title: Windows on Arm FAQ
sources.finding: x86/x64 user app emulation does not emulate drivers; Arm64 drivers required. Native Visual Studio/VS Code exist. Arm Hyper-V guests supported.

sources.title: Multi-platform builds
sources.finding: Containers depend on host kernel/architecture. QEMU can be much slower for compilation; native builds/cross-compilation alternatives.

sources.title: Docker Desktop on Mac
sources.finding: 4GB minimum; current and two previous macOS releases. Rosetta recommended not strictly required. Licensing varies by organization size/use.

sources.title: Start locally

sources.title: MPS backend
